title: NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series
desc: The NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series holds its playoff Chase race at Phoenix Raceway. Drivers battle for 150 laps covering a total of 150 miles. Standings leader Kaden Honeycutt guides the field with 2,251 points ahead of rival Layne Riggs.

title: College Football
desc: The No. 5 Indiana Hoosiers host the No. 4 Ohio State Buckeyes for a top-five Big Ten conference showdown. The Hoosiers and Buckeyes are both 3-0 in league play. Indiana relies on Josh Hoover to lead the team, while Julian Sayin leads Ohio State.

title: College Football
desc: The Washington Huskies visit the Purdue Boilermakers. Washington lost 41-24 to No. 17 Iowa, extending their losing streak to three games. Elijah Brown threw three touchdowns. Purdue beat Minnesota 41-13, with Fame Ijeboi rushing for 195 yards.

title: College Football
desc: No. 10 Texas Tech Red Raiders host the Arizona State Sun Devils at Galaxy Stadium. Texas Tech looks to J'Koby Williams following a 29-7 victory against Colorado, while Arizona State relies on wide receiver Reed Harris after his two touchdown catches.
